name: Primeval Fury
body:
You summon the primal rage within for a short time.

Prerequisite: BAB +1.

Benefit: As a swift action 1/day, you tap into a primal fury within to gain a +2 bonus to damage on melee attacks and 10 temporary hp. This lasts a number of rounds equal to 2 + your Constitution bonus.
